_meta.what: Probe ids whose transcripts deterministically trip the Anthropic Usage Policy classifier (child-tutor + body/biology vocabulary in Tagalog/Cebuano). These must NEVER enter a Claude context — not a subagent's, not the main session's (in-session judging killed the main session 2026-06-12). Judge them with judge-local.mjs against a local model instead.
_meta.trigger_cluster: dugo (blood), tiyan/sumasakit (stomach/pain), buto/bukog (seed/bone), lason (poison), plant-kept-in-dark-room, first-person child medical symptoms
_meta.how_built: lexeme scan over probe+answer text (ids only, content never printed) + the known 2026-06-10 kill set; generous on body/medical, tight elsewhere — a false negative only costs one killed workflow agent (it lands in `unjudged` and gets local-judged in the mop-up)
_meta.validated: 2026-06-12: with these 20 excluded, the 114-probe judging workflow ran with ZERO classifier kills (round 1, no retries needed)
